name: ThinkCaptcha – Login Captcha, Register Captcha & Checkout reCAPTCHA
author: ThinkPlugin

sections.description:
Enhance Your Website’s Login Security with the Power of Google reCAPTCHA

Are you tired of spam registrations, brute-force login attacks, and junk form submissions?
ThinkCaptcha is the definitive Google reCAPTCHA plugin for WordPress, designed to provide maximum login security with a simple and modern interface.
ThinkCaptcha allows you to easily add a login captcha, register captcha, and password reset captcha to your most vulnerable forms using Google’s user-friendly “I’m not a robot” checkbox (reCAPTCHA v2).
This is the ultimate spam protection and bot protection your site needs.
Free Features for Essential Security:

  • WordPress Login Captcha: Implement a secure login captcha on your /wp-login.php page to stop brute-force attacks and enhance login security.
  • WooCommerce Login Captcha: Protect your customer accounts by adding a WooCommerce captcha to the login form.
  • WooCommerce Register Captcha: Stop fake user sign-ups with a robust register captcha on your WooCommerce registration form.
  • Password Reset Captcha: Secure both WordPress and WooCommerce password reset forms from bot abuse.
  • Optimized for Performance: The Google reCAPTCHA script loads asynchronously and only on pages where it is needed.

🚀 Upgrade to ThinkCaptcha Pro for Ultimate Form Security!

Spammers target every form on your site.
ThinkCaptcha Pro extends this powerful reCAPTCHA protection to create a comprehensive security shield.

  • WooCommerce Checkout Captcha: The best way to prevent fraudulent orders and spam.
    Add a checkout captcha to your WooCommerce checkout page.
  • Contact Form 7 reCAPTCHA: Our most requested feature!
    Add a Contact Form 7 reCAPTCHA to every contact form and eliminate junk mail forever.
  • WPForms Captcha: Secure all forms created with WPForms with a powerful WPForms captcha.
  • WordPress Register Captcha: Block spambots from creating user accounts on your main WordPress registration form with a secure register captcha.
  • Secure your entire website today. Get ThinkCaptcha Pro Now!

Third-Party Service Disclosure

This plugin connects to the Google reCAPTCHA service to protect forms from bots and spam.
* Service Used: Google reCAPTCHA (a service provided by Google LLC).
* What Data is Sent: To verify if a user is human, this service collects and sends hardware and software information, such as device and application data, to Google.
The user’s IP address is also collected.
* When Data is Sent: This data is sent whenever a form protected by this plugin is displayed and submitted.
* Links to Policies: The use of the Google reCAPTCHA service is subject to Google’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the thinkcaptcha folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “ThinkCaptcha” menu in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Visit the Google reCAPTCHA admin console to get your Site Key and Secret Key for reCAPTCHA v2 (“I’m not a robot” Checkbox).
  5. Copy and paste your keys into the plugin’s settings page to begin protecting your forms with reCAPTCHA.
  6. Use the simple toggles to enable the login captcha, register captcha, or other forms.
  7. Save changes, and your form security is active!
sections.faq:
How do I add a login captcha for WordPress login security?

ThinkCaptcha makes it easy. After installing and adding your Google reCAPTCHA keys, simply go to the ThinkCaptcha settings page and toggle on “WordPress – Login Form”.
A secure login captcha will automatically be added to your login page, dramatically improving your site’s login security against brute-force attacks.

How can I add Google reCAPTCHA to my WooCommerce forms?

Our plugin offers deep integration with WooCommerce.
You can add a WooCommerce captcha to the login, registration, and password reset forms directly from our settings panel with a single click.
The Pro version also allows you to add a checkout captcha.

Does this plugin work as a Contact Form 7 reCAPTCHA solution?

Yes!
The Pro version is the perfect Contact Form 7 reCAPTCHA plugin.
It automatically integrates with all your CF7 forms to block spam submissions effectively.

What is the difference between a captcha and reCAPTCHA?

“Captcha” is the general term for a test to tell humans and bots apart.
“reCAPTCHA” is Google’s specific, advanced version of a captcha, which uses sophisticated risk analysis to provide a better user experience.
ThinkCaptcha uses Google’s secure and user-friendly reCAPTCHA v2.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No.
The plugin is lightweight, and the Google reCAPTCHA script is loaded asynchronously using WordPress best practices, meaning it doesn’t block your page from loading.
It only loads on pages where the captcha is active.
